# Synthetic fixtures only

These hexadecimal fixtures contain no speech, chat, personal information or original plugin assets. They were created locally from mathematical 440 Hz tones with the pinned SDKs. SILK uses a 16000-sample mono 16 kHz input: first 8000 samples zero, then `int(12000*sin(2*pi*440*i/16000))`; standard and Tencent headers wrap the same one-second signal. AMR uses 50 MR122 frames, each 160 mono 8 kHz samples `int(10000*sin(2*pi*440*i/8000))`, one second total. Files are hex text to keep the release whitelist auditable. New native tests decode them through the production parser and WUVoiceDecode, not the upstream sample CLI. These generated fixtures may be freely used, modified and redistributed for testing; upstream codec license/patent notices still apply to the decoder implementation.
